outcome.answer: The closest matches are [1], [2], [7], and [10]. [1] directly models watch-time distributions with a hierarchical exponential-Gaussian mixture, while [2] models a joint watch-time distribution over four watch states and serves probabilities and uncertainty, not just a single estimate. [7] uses residual quantization to predict continuous values like watch-time, but it is not a mixture model. [10] is a residual quantized Gaussian mixture model, but it is for CTR prediction rather than watch time.
